products: sale of water for domestic, industrial, public, and irrigation uses
water for domestic and municipal fire protection services
segments.description: Supplies, treats and distributes water and provides wastewater collection and treatment, plus non-regulated water system operation, to homes, businesses and municipalities.
segments.evidence: We operate in one reportable segment, the supply and distribution of water services and the provision of wastewater services.

revenueModel.text: Customers in our regulated service areas pay commission-set water and wastewater rates, while municipalities and private companies pay negotiated fees for contracted services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Commissions have plenary powers to set both rates and operating standards.
